Balara, District Sikar, Raj.
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp.
2.

Mohan Singh S/o Shri Bhanwar Singh Aged About 46  Years, R/o House No.49, Ramvihar B, Meenawala, Sirsi  Road, Jaipur, Raj.
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : None For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.S. Mehla, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN  Order 15/07/2024 The present petition has been filed for the quashing of criminal proceedings in FIR No. 264/2015 under Sections 420, 406, 419, 140 & 170, IPC registered at Police Station, Karni Vihar, Jaipur (West), on account of a compromise entered inter se between the parties.
None of the compromising parties has marked presence, before this Court.

Upon a perusal of the record, it is noted that no sincere efforts have been taken by the petitioners,
ever since filing of the instant petition.

On the directions of this Court, for furnishing a status report,
a letter dated 14.05.2024 was received, which reflects that the proceedings are ongoing before the learned Trial Court.

This Court deems it appropriate to dismiss the same.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed, with liberty to revive the same if need so arises.
Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.

(SAMEER JAIN),J ANIL SHARMA /57 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
